main_body: snow-covered wooden house with pitched roof and timber front wall
top_band: snow-covered sloped roof surface in white and pale blue-grey scallops from row 8 to row 51
evidence: The main body shows a large foreshortened sloped roof (rows 8-51, 44 rows tall) above a vertical wooden south wall (rows 52-76, 25 rows tall). Row 51 forms a distinct front-edge eave rim, rows 52-54 show eave shadow and icicles over the recessed wall, and the double doors and windows are inset with dark framing.

style.evidence: The snow roof uses 6 lightness steps of white/blue-grey arranged in rich scalloped clumps with moss patches, and the timber wall uses 5-6 brown steps with individual plank grain, matching the Beodeul reference buildings in density and craft.
